params.name: data
params.description: Optional. Data for populating the Message object.

params.name: data.chunks
params.description: A collection of a row's contents as part of the read request.

params.name: data.last_scanned_row_key
params.description: Optionally the server might return the row key of the last row it has scanned. The client can use this to construct a more efficient retry request if needed: any row keys or portions of ranges less than this row key can be dropped from the request. This is primarily useful for cases where the server has read a lot of data that was filtered out since the last committed row key, allowing the client to skip that work on a retry.
